title: Polyatomic Posse: Polyatomic Ions — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)

chapters.CHEM 3A: Chapter 4: naming ions and compounds (Green Sheet polyatomic ions)
chapters.CHEM 1A: Chapter 2: chemical nomenclature (Green Sheet polyatomic ions)

description: Polyatomic ion practice built on the Green Sheet, for CHEM 3A and CHEM 1A (default 1A; add ?course=3A). Every one of the 30 Green Sheet ions (oxyanion table, other common ions, naming-rule examples and sulfite from the solubility table, including both acetate formulas). Four games: Name → Formula & Charge, Formula → Name, The -ate/-ite Family (given chlorate, build perchlorate, chlorite and hypochlorite; given sulfate, find sulfite; carbonate to hydrogen carbonate; phosphate to hydrogen and dihydrogen phosphate), and Charge Check (tap just the charge), plus Skill Check Prep: 10 mixed questions, then a study plan with the missed ions and mistake types. Smart typing turns SO4^2-, SO42- or SO4-2 into SO₄²⁻, and the formula and the charge are graded separately. Mistake catchers name the slip: -ite/-ate swap, per-/hypo- mix-up, charge sign, charge size, missing subscript, ammonium is positive, and the hydrogen- prefix (one less negative). Decks don't repeat an ion until the set is done. Hints, step-by-step help, Professor Tips, a Green Sheet ion list, a periodic table, XP, ranks and 10 achievements.
